name: pg_ai
abstract: PostgreSQL AI Edition: embeddings, semantic search, RAG and agents inside PostgreSQL
description: An installable PostgreSQL extension that adds embeddings, semantic search, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agents with memory, and filtered ANN search, orchestrating local (Ollama) or remote model APIs. Ships with pg_ai_core, a native C extension that integrates a planner hook and AI-workload telemetry into the engine.

pg_ai.abstract: Embeddings, semantic search, RAG, agents, filtered ANN search

pg_ai_core.abstract: Native C planner-hook integration and AI-workload telemetry (V2 pilot)
